incident-bot: ALERT: EvalGate fired for route /api/generate -> reason: output-drift (factuality drop). Model: rwd-v3-7b-quant. Drift score=0.67 (threshold 0.45). PagerDuty incident PD-INC-4987 created and paged.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: PD-INC-4987 | Trigger: eval-output-drift | Urgency: high | Run: https://evals.internal/runs/12421 | Actions: page primary on-call

marina (oncall): Ack PD-INC-4987. I'm taking lead. Any immediate customer alerts?

dave (ml-eng): Pulling eval artifacts. Quick glance: factuality and date normalization regressions on summarization and Q&A. Correlation with last-night "auto-quantize" job that promoted rwd-v3-7b-quant to canary. Repro locally.

naya (support): We've got three P1 tickets from two customers reporting bad dates and invented numbers in summaries. Ticket notes: "meeting happened on April 4th" -> model says "April 14th" in output. CS has flagged as critical.

tori (sre): Infra looks green. No OOMs, no GPU driver faults. Request rates normal. Quality signal pipeline (eval-gate) is the source of alert.

dave (ml-eng): Example outputs from failing eval run:

```
PROMPT: Summarize the notes below.
EXPECTED: "Project kickoff was on 2025-04-03."
OUTPUT (quant): "Project kickoff on 2025-04-30."
OUTPUT (stable): "Project kickoff on 2025-04-03."
```

clara (product): Customer impact = high for summarization; enterprise SLAs at risk. Recommend immediate mitigation: redirect production route to rwd-v3-7b-stable for /api/generate while we investigate. Also disable the auto-promote job until root cause understood.

marina (oncall): Plan: (A) switch /api/generate traffic to stable model at 100% via routing control, (B) pause auto-quantize promotions, (C) notify affected customers, (D) create postmortem ticket INF-1832. Assigning action owners.

tori (sre): I'll execute routing change. Running controlplane command now:

```
# promote stable model for /api/generate
http POST https://controlplane.internal/routes/switch \
  Authorization:"Bearer $CP_TOKEN" route=/api/generate model=rwd-v3-7b-stable pct=100
```

tori (sre): initiating... ops-bot will post status updates.

ops-bot: Route update: /api/generate -> rwd-v3-7b-stable (100%). Rolling health checks.

infra-bot: Auto-promotion job eval-roller paused for model family rwd-v3. Cron disabled.

dave (ml-eng): Running quick checks against stable in production traffic mirror: factuality metrics back to baseline within 3 minutes of switch. Will snapshot failing inputs and register regression set: regression-4987-2025.

naya (support): Sent short status to affected customers: initial notice + mitigation steps + expected follow-up in 2 hours. Ticket numbers updated.

marina (oncall): Handoff: I'll stay until confirmation that quality metrics are stable for 30 minutes. If anything regresses after 02:00 UTC escalate to eng-oncall (set of rotation contacts in #eng-oncall). Recording timeline in INF-1832.

tori (sre): Observability: drift_alert_count dropped to 0 after route switch. Latency nominal. No error spike.

ops-bot: PD-INC-4987 status=mitigated | mitigation=route-fallback-to rwd-v3-7b-stable | impacted_customers=2 | start=2180034567 | mitigated=2180034710

marina (oncall): Confirming mitigation. Creating follow-up tickets: INF-1832 (postmortem + regression investigation) assigned to dave and tori. Clara to lead customer comms.

dave (ml-eng): Next steps: bisect quantization commit diff, run full prompt corpus against quant vs stable, add eval-gate checks for date/factuality tokens, and block auto-promote until fixes deployed. Will attach findings to INF-1832.

clara (product): I'll draft customer incident note and coordinate legal/CS for any SLA concerns. Thank you all. We'll aim to publish initial postmortem within 48h.

marina (oncall): Closing PD after postmortem ticket created and customer comms in flight. Keeping channel for investigation updates. If re-opened, update PD and notify rotation.

incident-bot: INCIDENT PD-INC-4987  RESOLVED (mitigated) | Severity: P1 -> mitigated by routing rollback. Postmortem: https://pm.internal/INF-1832
